verdict.rationale: Drata's public API v2 covers many core objects. It offers create/update operations for controls, policies and policy versions, custom frameworks, evidence library items, custom connections, and monitoring tests, plus personnel, device, risk, and audit endpoints and claimed programmatic trust-center management. However, the evidence shows no stated UI-parity guarantee, and several areas appear read-only (Audits list/get only, Risks list only) or experimental (the 🧪 device endpoint). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, evidenced write coverage for risks, audits, and personnel, and independent or hands-on confirmation that UI workflows can be fully replicated via the API.
